name: mfg-video-matrix
description: 制造业短视频矩阵智能分发系统 - 社媒分发 + GEO搜索获客双引擎 · 数字人IP · 智能爆款二创

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mvms/backend prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @mvms/shared build && pnpm --filter @mvms/backend build && pnpm --filter @mvms/frontend build
scripts.db:up: sh scripts/host-browser-bridge.sh start && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:down: docker compose down && sh scripts/host-browser-bridge.sh stop
scripts.deploy:down: docker compose --profile app down && sh scripts/host-browser-bridge.sh stop
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mvms/backend prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @mvms/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck
